info.description: Stable REST API for tracked ad intelligence across Meta, TikTok, and Google. Authenticate with OAuth 2.0 client_credentials.

payer_name.description: "Paid for by" entity from the ad detail page.

country_impressions.description: Per-country impression shares from the latest snapshot.

gid.description: Canonical global id. Use the slash-free form in path params.

id_token.description: Slash-free id token for use in URL path segments.

query.description: Facebook page name, handle, or numeric page id. A numeric id is matched exactly; otherwise the top page-search result is tracked.

pending_ingest.description: True when the ingest crawl has not completed yet.

ad_id.description: A TikTok ad api_id; the parent advertiser is resolved from it server-side.

advertiser_id.description: A Google Ad Library advertiser id.

company_id.description: Exact LinkedIn /company/{id} key (numeric id or vanity slug).

company_url.description: LinkedIn company URL, e.g. https://www.linkedin.com/company/microsoft/. The /company/ segment is used as the exact key.

name.description: Advertiser display name. Must uniquely match an already-discovered advertiser; otherwise a discovery crawl is started and the request should be retried.

gid.description: Canonical global id. Use the slash-free form in path params.

id_token.description: Slash-free id token for use in URL path segments.

follower_count.description: Latest crawled follower count, when known.

handle.description: Account handle to track — an @handle, a bare handle, or a profile URL (tiktok.com/@x, instagram.com/x). Tracking kicks off a crawl; posts appear a few minutes later.

pending_ingest.description: True when the ingest crawl has not completed yet.

advertisers.description: Display names of tracked advertisers targeting this region.

impressions.description: Prorated impressions for the bucket (upper bound).

awaiting_count.description: Ads still awaiting an impression estimate.
